title: Coupled-Cluster Imaginary-Time Evolution and the Coupled-Cluster Energy Variance
summary: We discuss a coupled-cluster formalism for carrying out imaginary-time evolution from an arbitrary reference, and study the properties of the resulting evolution trajectories. The evolution converges to a solution of the standard coupled-cluster amplitude equations in the long-time limit if a finite valued limit exists, but when such a limit does not exist, the trajectories still contain additional information beyond the standard solutions.
